teaser: One version of you refuses the last slice of cake until everyone else has had one. Another closes the blinds and does not answer the door for a week. You are a life path 6 and an ISFP. The 6 keeps house for the people it loves; the ISFP keeps its own weather private. What's particular in you is how far the caretaking goes before it asks anything for itself, and how quietly it stops asking at all.
